_meta.description: Explicit permission key list for every system role. This is the authoritative seed data for the role_permissions table. Keys marked [PLAN_LOCKED] are gated by plan_features at runtime — the role possesses them but the plan check blocks execution. Keys marked [CONFIGURABLE] can be toggled per-member by ACCOUNT_OWNER or WORKSPACE_ADMIN.
_meta.how_to_read: If a key appears in this list the role has it. Absence = no access. Plan checks and ABAC conditions are applied on top at runtime — see ABAC_CONDITIONS.md.

SUPER_ADMIN._note: Wildcard — all permissions granted. Never enumerate individually. Checked via platform_role in app_metadata.

PLATFORM_ADMIN._scope: Platform-wide. No workspace/brand data access by default.

SUPPORT_ADMIN._scope: Read-only view of platform accounts. Time-limited workspace read access via ticket grant.
SUPPORT_ADMIN._cannot: Never sees billing, AI keys, system settings, or subscription data.

BILLING_ADMIN._scope: Financial data only. No brand content, no users management.

TECHNICAL_ADMIN._scope: Infrastructure and integrations only. No customer data.

ACCOUNT_OWNER._scope: Full control over own workspace and all brands within it.

WORKSPACE_ADMIN._scope: Full workspace operations. Cannot manage billing, delete workspace, or grant roles above BRAND_MANAGER.
WORKSPACE_ADMIN._inherits: All BRAND_MANAGER permissions plus workspace management keys below.

BRAND_MANAGER._scope: Full operational control over assigned brands. No workspace management.

CONTENT_MANAGER._scope: Content creation and scheduling for assigned brands.
CONTENT_MANAGER._cannot: Connect integrations, manage team, approve designs (unless configured), view financial KPIs, inbox management.

DESIGNER._scope: Design creation and asset management for assigned brands.
DESIGNER._cannot: Post to social, manage inbox, view analytics (except design dashboard), connect integrations.

SOCIAL_MEDIA_MANAGER._scope: Social publishing, community management, and inbox for assigned brands.
SOCIAL_MEDIA_MANAGER._cannot: Connect/disconnect integrations, manage billing, view financial KPIs, create CRM records unless explicitly granted.

ADS_MANAGER._scope: Paid media management for assigned brands.
ADS_MANAGER._cannot: Social inbox, content approval, billing, team management.
ADS_MANAGER._note: ads.financial_metrics.view.brand and ads.roas.view.brand are [CONFIGURABLE] — owner can revoke.

SEO_SPECIALIST._scope: SEO strategy, content, and technical recommendations for assigned brands.
SEO_SPECIALIST._cannot: Social posting, ads management, inbox, billing.

INBOX_AGENT._scope: Assigned conversations only. First-line response agent.
INBOX_AGENT._cannot: View all conversations, manage integrations, export data, financial KPIs, content creation.
INBOX_AGENT._note: inbox.leads.create.brand and inbox.orders.create.brand are [CONFIGURABLE] — off by default.

ANALYST._scope: Read and export analytics for assigned brands.
ANALYST._cannot: Create/edit content, manage inbox, social posting, billing, integrations.

CRM_SALES_AGENT._scope: Sales pipeline and customer relationship management.
CRM_SALES_AGENT._cannot: View all inbox (only assigned), content ops, ads, design, integrations management.

FINANCE_VIEWER._scope: Read-only financial data within the workspace.
FINANCE_VIEWER._cannot: Any write operations. Content, inbox, integrations, CRM data.

CLIENT_VIEWER._scope: External client — view-only access to explicitly shared brands' reports and dashboards.
CLIENT_VIEWER._cannot: All write operations. Billing, team, integrations, inbox, CRM, content creation.

EXTERNAL_CONTRACTOR._scope: No default access. Only explicit per-project grants via permission_overrides.
EXTERNAL_CONTRACTOR._note: These are the ONLY universally-safe defaults for any contractor. Everything else must be explicitly granted via permission_overrides with an expires_at date.

VIEWER._scope: Passive observer. Read-only across minimal modules.
